name: Yao Narumi
source:
A woman who came to the park on a date with her husband.

She had visited here before they were married; it was where Narumi proposed to her, and they became a couple.
Her husband is younger than her and is the type of man often referred to as a “herbivore man.”

They were childhood friends, and Narumi had always tended to lead him around by the nose.
Drawn to her childhood friend, who hadn’t changed a bit, she began contacting him again, and they eventually got married.

Although she sometimes feels frustrated with her husband—who is rather shy and a bit unreliable—they have built a good marriage.
Partly because her husband isn’t very proactive, they don’t have any children yet.
